title: Victoria of Many Faces TV Anime Reveals July 7 Debut in Short Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a short promotional video and the anime's July 7 debut on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'World Is Dancing' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuto Mihara 's World Is Dancing manga revealed additional cast, a character visual (pictured above), and the second promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 2 at 10:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga revealed three new cast members for the anime on Friday. The new cast members include (left to right in above image): • Saori Hayami as Emeraude • Yūki Ono as Zagato • Mika Kikuchi as Mokona Anime Expo will host the anime's world premiere…
author: ANN

title: The World is Dancing Anime's Music Trailer Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the television anime of Kazuto Mihara 's The World Is Dancing manga revealed a new music trailer and new cast members for the anime on Friday. The trailer features the vocal insert song performances of Yumiri Hanamori and Romi Park , as their respective characters Oniyasha and Zojiro.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Summer of You Series Reveals 5 Cast Members
content: The official website for the live-action series of Nagisa Furuya 's The Summer of You boys love manga revealed five new cast members for the series on Friday. title: Mononoke Film Trilogy Producer Kōji Yamamoto Retires from Producing, Apologizes After Recasting Takahiro Sakurai in 3rd Film
content: Kōji Yamamoto , planning producer for the Mononoke franchise's film trilogy , posted an apology on his X (formerly Twitter ) account on Friday, and also announced he was retiring from producing.
author: ANN

title: KAMUI: He's Behind You Anime's New Video Reveals July 3 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime of author Eroki and artist Shinko Konoshiro 's KAMUI: He's Behind You ( Ushiro no Shōmen Kamui-san ) manga unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the anime on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film's 2nd Trailer Reveals Ado's Theme Song
content: The official website for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga unveiled the second trailer and poster visual for the film on Friday. The trailer reveals and previews the film's theme song "Monstruo" by Ado .
author: ANN

title: My Cold Co-worker Obsessively Loves Me Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: TV Tokyo announced on Friday that it is producing a live-action series adaptation of Peki Aoi 's My Cold Co-worker Obsessively Loves Me ( Dry na Dōki no Dekiai Heki ) manga that will premiere on the BS TV Tokyo channel on July 8.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Is Streaming Anticipated New Anime Ahead of Its Summer 2026 Premiere
content: The Spring 2026 anime season is finally here, and the lineup looks as exciting as ever. 2026 kicked off with some of the biggest anime in recent years, including Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, and many more.
author: ComicBook
